paragraphs.source_en: “This battle may well rival the late Lord Ufu’s great victory at Dengakuhazama.”

units.source_en: “This battle may well rival the late Lord Ufu’s great victory at Dengakuhazama.”
units.source_zh: “此战可以和已故右府大人在田乐洼的那场大战媲美。”

units.source_en: “Until I return, I entrust you with the grave responsibility of supreme command, Hidenaga.”
units.source_zh: “在我回来之前，总大将的重任就交给你了，秀长。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes! Hidenaga will spare neither life nor limb!”

units.source_en: “Yes! Hidenaga will spare neither life nor limb!”
units.source_zh: “是，秀长肝脑涂地，在所不辞！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是，秀长肝脑涂地，在所不辞！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Kanbei will serve as strategist. The enemy’s first target is more likely to be Nakagawa Kiyohide on Mount Ōiwa than Hori Hidemasa on Mount Sone.”

paragraphs.source_en: “The fighting is certain to begin in this vicinity.”

paragraphs.source_en: The next morning, Hideyoshi rode through the encampments, inspecting the dispositions of both armies. His retinue included young hatamoto warriors, his adopted son Hidekatsu, his nephew Hidetsugu, Konishi Yukinaga, Ishida Sakichi, and others. Hideyoshi was truly a mercurial man: yesterday he had been in exuberant spirits, but today his face was stern as frost.

units.source_en: The next morning, Hideyoshi rode through the encampments, inspecting the dispositions of both armies.

units.source_en: His retinue included young hatamoto warriors, his adopted son Hidekatsu, his nephew Hidetsugu, Konishi Yukinaga, Ishida Sakichi, and others.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi was truly a mercurial man: yesterday he had been in exuberant spirits, but today his face was stern as frost.
units.source_zh: 秀吉可真是善变之人，昨天还意气风发，今天却满面严霜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 次日晨，秀吉骑马巡营，察看双方的排兵布阵情况。随从的人员中既有年轻的旗本武士，也有秀吉的养子秀胜、外甥秀次、小西行长、石田佐吉等人。秀吉可真是善变之人，昨天还意气风发，今天却满面严霜。

paragraphs.source_en: Looking where Hideyoshi pointed, they saw the Hokkokudō highway streaming like a ribbon from the main camp at Kinomoto and winding through the mountain ravines. On both sides of the road, towering mountains stretched away without end.

units.source_en: Looking where Hideyoshi pointed, they saw the Hokkokudō highway streaming like a ribbon from the main camp at Kinomoto and winding through the mountain ravines.
units.source_zh: 顺着秀吉所指望去，只见北国的官道像一条带子，从木本的大营里飘出来，在山涧里蜿蜒盘旋。

units.source_en: On both sides of the road, towering mountains stretched away without end.
units.source_zh: 道路两侧是漫无边际的巍巍高山。

paragraphs.source_zh: 顺着秀吉所指望去，只见北国的官道像一条带子，从木本的大营里飘出来，在山涧里蜿蜒盘旋。道路两侧是漫无边际的巍巍高山。

paragraphs.source_en: West of the road, beside Mount Shizugatake, stood Mount Ōiwa, held by Nakagawa Sebei Kiyohide; to the east was Mount Tagami, where the detached force under Hideyoshi’s younger brother Hidenaga was encamped. Beyond Shizugatake lay Mount Iwasaki, Mount Shinmei, Mount Dōgi, and Mount Tenjin; Mount Tenjin and Mount Sone to the east formed Hideyoshi’s front line.

units.source_en: West of the road, beside Mount Shizugatake, stood Mount Ōiwa, held by Nakagawa Sebei Kiyohide; to the east was Mount Tagami, where the detached force under Hideyoshi’s younger brother Hidenaga was encamped.
units.source_zh: 路西侧，贱岳的旁边就是中川濑兵卫清秀驻守的大岩山，东侧则是秀吉的弟弟秀长的别动队屯驻的田上山。

paragraphs.source_en: Now lowering his head in thought, now gauging the heights of the mountains by eye, Hideyoshi urged his horse onward until at last he reached the foremost position on Mount Sone and inspected Hori Hidemasa’s defenses. Standing on the summit, he looked down upon the highway, which stretched like a sash of jade to the foot of Mount Uch中ao. After a while, he raised a hand to shade his eyes and gazed at Katsuie’s banners fluttering in the wind atop Mount Uch中ao.

units.source_en: Now lowering his head in thought, now gauging the heights of the mountains by eye, Hideyoshi urged his horse onward until at last he reached the foremost position on Mount Sone and inspected Hori Hidemasa’s defenses.

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉时而低头沉思，时而目测山的高度，催马前行，最后来到了位于左祢山的最前线，察看堀秀政的布防情况。他站在山顶上，俯视着脚下玉带一样延伸到内中尾山麓的官道。过了一会儿，他又手搭凉棚，眺望胜家在内中尾山顶迎风招展的旗幡。

paragraphs.source_en: “Yoshitsugu.”

units.source_en: “Yoshitsugu.”
units.source_zh: “吉继。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “吉继。”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord!” Startled by Hideyoshi’s sudden summons, Yoshitsugu, whose original name was Ōtani Heima, was about to dismount when Hideyoshi stopped him. “No need to dismount. What is your impression?”

units.source_en: “My lord!”
Startled by Hideyoshi’s sudden summons, Yoshitsugu, whose original name was Ōtani Heima, was about to dismount when Hideyoshi stopped him.

units.source_en: “No need to dismount.
units.source_zh: “不用下马了。

units.source_en: What is your impression?”
units.source_zh: 有什么感觉？”

paragraphs.source_en: “What does my lord mean?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公的意思是……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Judging from the dispositions of the two armies, which side do you think is more likely to prevail?”

units.source_en: “Judging from the dispositions of the two armies, which side do you think is more likely to prevail?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “从敌我双方的布阵来看，你认为哪一方容易获胜？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Well... naturally, our side holds the advantage...”

units.source_en: “Well... naturally, our side holds the advantage...”
units.source_zh: “这……当然还是我方处于优势……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这……当然还是我方处于优势……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Is that truly what you believe in your heart?” At some point, the close retainers had gathered around the two men and were listening with bated breath. Hideyoshi had plainly noticed them; he deliberately raised his voice and repeated the question sternly.

units.source_en: “Is that truly what you believe in your heart?”
units.source_zh: “你心底就是这样想的？”

units.source_zh: 秀吉显然是意识到了，故意提高了嗓门，严厉地反问道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “你心底就是这样想的？”不知何时，近臣们都来到了二人的身边，屏息凝神听着。秀吉显然是意识到了，故意提高了嗓门，严厉地反问道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Of course. Otherwise, why would Yoshitsugu still follow my lord?”

units.source_en: “Of course.
units.source_zh: “当然。

units.source_en: Otherwise, why would Yoshitsugu still follow my lord?”
units.source_zh: 否则，吉继为何还追随主公呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hmph... I suppose you are right. If even you can see that the advantage lies with us, then this campaign is certain to become a protracted struggle.”

units.source_zh: “敌人所看到的，一定会跟你现在所看到的一样。

units.source_zh: 他们更不会轻易出来了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord sees truly... If the enemy judges matters in the same way, this war may indeed turn into a protracted struggle.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Precisely. Once the two sides settle into a standoff, we must alter our strategy as well. After all, this is not the only place where war is being waged...”

units.source_zh: “不错。

paragraphs.source_en: That night, Hideyoshi stayed in Hori Hidemasa’s camp. The following day, he went to Mount Fumuro, a height west of Mount Tenjin, to observe the enemy. As he surveyed the terrain, he repeatedly marked the deployment map, jotting down oddly shaped symbols, and then hurried back to the main camp at Kinomoto.

units.source_en: Amid the swirl of rumors, on the twenty-eighth day of the third month Hideyoshi too withdrew to Nagahama Castle under the pretext of resting his troops.
units.source_zh: 就在流言漫天的时候，三月二十八，秀吉也以休整为名，撤到了长滨城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在流言漫天的时候，三月二十八，秀吉也以休整为名，撤到了长滨城。

paragraphs.source_en: On the fourth day of the fourth month, Tsutsui Junkei withdrew to Yamato.

units.source_en: On the fourth day of the fourth month, Tsutsui Junkei withdrew to Yamato.
units.source_zh: 四月初四，筒井顺庆撤回了大和。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四月初四，筒井顺庆撤回了大和。

paragraphs.source_en: At this time, Nobutaka also moved in concert with Katsuie. Around the thirteenth or fourteenth day of the fourth month, Inaba Ittetsu, who was attacking Shimizu Castle, and Ujiie Naomichi of Ōgaki Castle began killing and setting fires wherever they went.

units.source_en: At this time, Nobutaka also moved in concert with Katsuie. Around the thirteenth or fourteenth day of the fourth month, Inaba Ittetsu, who was attacking Shimizu Castle, and Ujiie Naomichi of Ōgaki Castle began killing and setting fires wherever they went.
units.source_zh: 此时，信孝也与胜家遥相呼应，四月十三四日前后，攻击清水城的稻叶一铁、大垣城的氏家直通，到处杀人放火。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，信孝也与胜家遥相呼应，四月十三四日前后，攻击清水城的稻叶一铁、大垣城的氏家直通，到处杀人放火。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus, amid the fresh green spreading across Mino and Ōmi, the hour for the two armies’ decisive battle gradually drew near.

units.source_en: Thus, amid the fresh green spreading across Mino and Ōmi, the hour for the two armies’ decisive battle gradually drew near.
units.source_zh: 就这样，两军决战的机会，渐渐地在披满新绿的美浓和近江一带来临了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就这样，两军决战的机会，渐渐地在披满新绿的美浓和近江一带来临了。
